description: Header file defining the QuicVersionManager class, which manages supported QUIC protocol versions, including filtering based on flags, and supports extension with custom ALPNs.

classes.name: quic::QuicVersionManager
classes.description: Manages supported QUIC versions, filtering based on flags, and supports custom ALPNs.

methods.name: GetSupportedVersions
methods.description: Returns the list of currently supported QUIC versions.

methods.name: GetSupportedAlpns
methods.description: Returns supported ALPNs based on current versions.

methods.name: MaybeRefilterSupportedVersions
methods.description: Refilters supported versions if flags have changed.

methods.name: RefilterSupportedVersions
methods.description: Virtual method to refilter supported versions based on flags.

methods.name: AddCustomAlpn
methods.description: Adds a custom ALPN to the supported list.
